The entire batch is rolled back if any item is invalid.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Applies sorting by the specified field:\
"?sort=+FieldName" for ascending order,\
"?sort=-FieldName" for descending order.\
\
Available fields are: Id, CreatedOn, ModifiedOn.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description:
What kind of items should be returned (only active items will be returned by default)\
Values: [True, Any, False]

parameters.name: parents
parameters.description:
Matches equipment whose direct parent is any of the supplied entries. Each entry requires both
id and type (Equipment or System); mixed types in one query are supported, e.g.
parents[0].id=42&parents[0].type=System&parents[1].id=99&parents[1].type=Equipment.

parameters.name: hasParent
parameters.description: true = has any parent; false = top-level (no parent).

parameters.name: systemIds
parameters.description:
Comma-separated system IDs. Filters by the resolved system, returning equipment at any level
attached to the system.

parameters.name: hasSystem
parameters.description: true = belongs to any system; false = unassigned.
